en.faqQ1: What services does Nahda Safety offer?
en.faqA1: We offer audits, compliance documentation, training, emergency planning, and AI-enabled risk advisory tailored for schools, hospitals, construction and oil & gas sites.
en.faqQ2: How do you support hospital safety?
en.faqA2: We provide infection control audits, patient handling guidance, clinical area risk assessments and staff training to improve patient and staff safety.
en.faqQ3: Can you help with construction site safety?
en.faqA3: Yes. We perform site inspections, toolbox talks, PPE selection, and permit-to-work systems for safe site operations.
en.faqQ4: Do you provide emergency & evacuation planning?
en.faqA4: We develop evacuation plans, run drills, and prepare emergency response procedures aligned with Omani regulations.
en.faqQ5: How do your AI safety insights work?
en.faqA5: Our AI tools analyse incident trends, compliance gaps and training needs to generate prioritised recommendations and action plans.
en.faqQ6: How can I get a quotation?
en.faqA6: Contact us via WhatsApp or email with your site details and we will provide a tailored proposal and timeline.
